basis: The y-axis is labeled 'Emergency department visits' with ascending tick labels (0, 800, 1600, 2400, 3200), so higher vertical position corresponds to a larger value. The plotted red line starts at a low vertex in 2012 (visually between the 800 and 1600 gridlines, approx. 1200) and ends at a much higher vertex in 2023 (visually at or just above the 3200 gridline). Because the later endpoint is plotted significantly higher than the earlier endpoint on a standard ascending scale, the overall utilization pattern over the review period is an increase. This supports the utilization-growth pathway. The chart title's claim of 'Declining' visits is refuted by the data geometry.
option_label: Route the emergency department visit record to utilization-growth follow-up
